It's good that you got to read 6 in a row to start your experience.  I first saw the series when there were only 2 books.  At one point long ago I actually had a peperbook copy of The Great Hunt before The Dragon Reborn had been published.  I want to say this was around 1991.  That GH copy is long lost now, and a shame too, because years later I learned that those early copies had subtle differences that make them valuable today - such as Lanfear's chapter icon having a moon that faced the opposite way.  

However, I well remember the agony of being a pre-teen awaiting books 3 and 4 in a time when - as a kid - I had no patience whatsoever.  That would change of course as the years passed and I started accepting the long waits between books.
